description: Tallow Fen bestiary wave 2 — Mire Widow pose variations. Separate wave because the Widow needs different negatives: the canon head is VEILED and FACELESS (wave-1 rendered a skull face both times — hard canon miss), and the tallow lantern-organ glows INSIDE the hollow chest (not a carried prop). Prompts derived from canon/tallow-fen-canon.md.
style_prefix: hand-painted oil-and-ink creature concept art, muted peat-and-tallow palette, soft charcoal outlines, a single warm lantern light in cold fen gloom, grim folkloric, matte painterly texture

defaults.negative: anime, manga, cartoon, cel shading, chibi, cute, photograph, photorealistic, 3d render, smooth CG, multiple creatures, human person, human face, modern gear, metal plate armor, gun, text, watermark, frame, border, signature, skull, skull face, bone face, exposed skull, skeleton face, eyes, mouth, teeth, grinning

subjects.prompt: a Mire Widow, a tall thin boneless biped about two and a half metres seen from the front, drooping forward, long sagging boneless arms trailing to the ground ending in fen-bone claws, draped head to foot in wet peat-flesh rags, its drooping head completely wrapped in a smooth featureless veil of wet cloth with no face at all, a translucent amber tallow lantern-organ glowing softly from inside its hollow chest cavity, warm light bleeding through the draped rags, colours bog green, peat black-brown, tallow gold glow, a single creature on a plain neutral background

a Mire Widow, a tall narrow drooping figure in profile bending forward like a wilting candle, boneless arms hanging long and trailing into the bog, draped in layers of wet peat-flesh rags, its head a smooth faceless drooping shape under a sodden veil, a soft amber glow of molten tallow shining from within its hollow chest and through the wet cloth, colours bog green, peat black-brown, tallow gold glow, a single creature on a plain dark background

a Mire Widow, a tall boneless biped at a three-quarter angle hunched low over black bog water, long sagging arms trailing in the pool, fen-bone claws spread, wet rag-draped body, the drooping head a blank veiled featureless mass of wet cloth, an amber tallow glow radiating from deep inside its hollow chest like a lure, colours bog green, peat black-brown, tallow gold glow, a single creature, plain misty background
